review.assessment: This change introduces a fresh `deepClone` implementation using `.map()` on arrays and spread syntax (`{ ... }`) on objects to create copies. These operations only perform shallow copying, meaning nested structures remain shared references rather than independent clones. Consequently, the function fails to meet the requirement of recursively cloning all levels, leaving mutations in the copy capable of altering the original data.

findings.call: const orig = { nested: { val: 42 } }; const copy = deepClone(orig); (copy.nested as any).val = 0; console.log((orig as any).nested.val)
findings.defect: Shallow copy instead of deep clone
